1.consolidated_definition: Azotarle. Pegarle. “A Juan se lo untaron”, ‘A Juan le pegaron’.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To administer a beating to someone. To give someone a thrashing. "Juan was given a beating", 'A thrashing was administered to Juan'.
